description: This file contains utility functions and classes related to handling IBM WatsonX models and authentication, including token generation, environment validation, message conversion templates, and credential management within the WatsonX AI context.

classes.name: WatsonXAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class for WatsonX API errors, inheriting from BaseLLMException, encapsulating HTTP status and message details.

classes.name: IBMWatsonXMixin
classes.description: A mixin class providing shared functionality for interacting with IBM WatsonX services, including environment validation, credential retrieval, URL management, and payload preparation.

methods.name: get_watsonx_iam_url()
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for obtaining IBM WatsonX IAM tokens, defaulting to IBM Cloud endpoint.

methods.name: str generate_iam_token(api_key=None, **params)
methods.description: Generates and caches an IAM token for WatsonX API access, handling API key retrieval and token request via HTTP.

methods.name: str _generate_watsonx_token(api_key: Optional[str], token: Optional[str])
methods.description: Returns provided token or generates a new one if None.

methods.name: WatsonXAPIParams _get_api_params( params: dict, )
methods.description: Extracts WatsonX API parameters from provided dictionary or environment variables, raising error if required parameters are missing.

methods.name: aconvert_watsonx_messages_core
methods.description: Asynchronous core logic for converting WatsonX messages into prompts using templates.

methods.name: str convert_watsonx_messages_to_prompt( model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], provider: str, custom_prompt_dict: Dict )

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: Dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and prepares authorization headers for WatsonX requests based on environment and optional parameters.

methods.name: str _get_base_url(self, api_base: Optional[str])
methods.description: Retrieves base URL for WatsonX API, raising error if not configured.

methods.name: str _add_api_version_to_url(self, url: str, api_version: Optional[str])

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[Dict, httpx.Headers] )
